definitions.explanation: Any device used to produce musical sounds. Covers traditional Japanese instruments, Western instruments, and electronic instruments alike.

examples.japanese: {何|なに}か{楽器|がっき}を{弾|ひ}けますか。
examples.english: Can you play any musical instrument?

examples.japanese: {子|こ}どものころにピアノという{楽器|がっき}に{出会|であ}った。
examples.english: I encountered the piano as an instrument when I was a child.

examples.japanese: この{店|みせ}では{和楽器|わがっき}から{洋楽器|ようがっき}まで{幅広|はばひろ}く{取|と}り{扱|あつか}っている。
examples.english: This shop carries a wide range of instruments, from traditional Japanese to Western.

notes:
ETYMOLOGY:
{楽|がく} (music) + {器|き} (instrument, vessel).

USAGE:
{楽器|がっき}を{弾|ひ}く is used for stringed and keyboard instruments, {楽器|がっき}を{吹|ふ}く for wind instruments, and {楽器|がっき}を{叩|たた}く for percussion. The general verb {演奏|えんそう}する (to perform) works for all types.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {楽器|がっき}を{演奏|えんそう}する: to play an instrument
- {楽器|がっき}を{習|なら}う: to learn an instrument
- {弦楽器|げんがっき}: stringed instrument
- {管楽器|かんがっき}: wind instrument
- {打楽器|だがっき}: percussion instrument
- {和楽器|わがっき}: traditional Japanese instrument
